Package com.ceichhorst.reservation.service

Class AvailabilityService

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ceichhorst.reservation.service.AvailabilityService
  • public class AvailabilityService
extends Object
    Service responsible for computing availability of ServiceInstance objects.

    This class contains read-only business logic used to determine which service instances are available for booking, as well as aggregating availability into calendar-style summaries.

    Availability is determined based on:

    • The requested service date
    • The restaurant's SchedulingType
    • The remaining capacity of each ServiceInstance

    • Method Detail

      • getAvailableTimes

        public List<ServiceInstance> getAvailableTimes​(Restaurant restaurant,
                                               List<ServiceInstance> services,
                                               LocalDate serviceDate,
                                               int partySize)
        Retrieves available service instances for a given restaurant and date.

        This method filters the provided list of services by:

        • Matching the specified serviceDate
        • Ensuring the service has remaining capacity

        The result is then adjusted based on the restaurant's SchedulingType:

        • DATE_ONLY: Returns at most one available service (date-level booking)
        • FIXED_TIME_SLOTS: Returns all available time slots
        • DATE_TIME: Returns all available time slots

        Results are ordered by service start time.

        Parameters:
        restaurant - the restaurant whose scheduling rules apply
        services - the list of service instances to evaluate
        serviceDate - the date for which availability is requested
        Returns:
        a list of available service instances

      • buildCalendar

        public List<DayAvailability> buildCalendar​(List<ServiceInstance> services,
                                           SchedulingType schedulingType)
        Builds a calendar-style view of availability grouped by date.

        This method aggregates a list of ServiceInstance objects into daily summaries represented by DayAvailability objects.

        For each date, the following values are calculated:

        • Total capacity (sum of all service capacities)
        • Total booked slots (sum of all reservation party sizes)
        • Whether the day is fully booked
        • Whether the day has any remaining availability

        Results are ordered chronologically by date.

        Parameters:
        services - the list of service instances to aggregate
        Returns:
        a list of DayAvailability objects representing daily availability
